newsitem.title: USA: Alternative Resources to buy back shares.
newsitem.headline: Alternative Resources to buy back shares.

text.p: Alternative Resources Corp said Wednesday its board of directors has authorized the repurchase of up to the lesser of 300,000 shares or $5 million of its common shares.
The annual commitment is to offset, in part, the dilutive effect of the company's stock option grants to management, the company said in a news release.
Shares will be purchased from time to time in the open market or through privately negotiated transactions, depending on market conditions and other factors, it said.
Shares purchased will be held in the corporate treasury and issued in connection with the company's existing incentive stock option plan.
As of June 30, 1997, the company had 15,711,018 shares outstanding.
Alternative Resources provides technical personnel and services for information technology operations.
Shares of Alternative Resources were trading up 1/2 to 22-3/4.
